videoTitle: GLP-1s Don't Just Make You Less Hungry—Here's What Else They Do
videoDescription: You've heard GLP-1 medications work by reducing appetite. But that's only part of the story—they also slow digestion, shift what foods you crave, and may change your gut signals in ways we're still learning about. Find out what's really happening beyond simple hunger suppression at mindtivate.com.
script: GLP-1s don't just make you less hungry. They actually slow how fast food leaves your stomach, shift your cravings away from high-fat and high-sugar foods, and the part most people don't know...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
